listen_addr.description: IP address to listen on for incoming DHCP requests.

listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on for DHCP requests (standard DHCP is 67).

server_address.description: DHCP server address to forward requests to (when operating in relay mode). Leave empty for standalone operation.

interfaces.description: List of network interface names to bind to. If empty, all interfaces are used.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty string means standard output.

request_handlers.description: List of plugins that handle incoming DHCP requests (e.g., assign IP, log, validate).

params.description: Plugin-specific parameters (e.g., filename, next-server for file handler).

response_modifiers.description: List of plugins that modify outgoing DHCP responses (e.g., vendor-class, options).

identity_mode.description: How clients are identified: 'mac' (standard MAC-based), 'duid' (for DHCPv6), or 'custom' (uses a custom key).

identity_custom_key.description: DHCP option code to use as identity key (only if identity_mode = 'custom'). Example: '61' (Client Identifier).

lease_db_path.description: File path for the persistent lease database.

persist_leases.description: Whether to persist leases to disk between restarts.

lease_ttl.description: Default lease duration in seconds (0 = infinite).

static_mappings.description: List of static MAC-to-IP/hostname mappings for fixed clients.

hostname.description: Hostname to assign (optional; leave blank to omit).

ip.description: Static IP address to assign (optional; omit if only hostname is desired).
